items.title: Awesome Go
items.content_text:
### Databases Implemented in Go

*   [MemHop (⭐6)](https://github.com/qyiun666/MemHop) - Embedded cognitive memory database for AI agents. Six-layer architecture (L0-L5), Dream consolidation pipeline, three-channel RRF retrieval (BM25 + f16 vector + entity), single .meh file, pure Go, zero infrastructure.

items.title: Awesome Smart Tv
items.content_text:
### Samsung Tizen / Other

*   [Beam-TV (⭐6)](https://github.com/TAGISWILD/beam-tv) - Open-source, no-account media player for Samsung Tizen TVs. Plays USB and local-network (DLNA) video/audio/subtitles directly on the TV (JavaScript).

items.title: Awesome Bitcoin
items.content_text:
### Utilities

*   [Freedom Clock](https://freedomclock.io) - Bitcoin-aware FIRE calculator with sell, borrow, and borrow-then-sell spend models. Converts savings and BTC holdings into years of financial freedom. Fully local, no account, MIT. Also an open-source e-ink desk device (\~$30).

items.title: Awesome Machine Learning
items.content_text:
### Python / General-Purpose Machine Learning

*   [Leanpass (⭐4)](https://github.com/Terminay/LeanPass) - A lightweight, NumPy-only autodiff library for small ML projects and learning how backpropagation works. It is 700x times lighter than Pytorch and 900x times lighter than TensorFlow.
